name: dv-agent-controller
description: Controller + subagents development policy: a fresh agent per task, tiered critical reviews, budget-first briefs, file-based reports and handovers, guarded autonomous runs, and STOP gates for outward writes.

interface.longDescription: Three documentation-only skills: a controller loop with a fresh agent per task and tiered reviews, agent brief templates, and rules for long or unattended runs. The generic implementer and critic agents are Claude Code only; in Codex use the skills.
defaultPrompt: Use the Agent Controller skills to run this multi-task development plan with fresh agents per task.
